title: bundant group.yml
description: A group is a namespace: members in install order plus explicit needs. The install order is the topological sort; a cycle is an error.

group.description: namespace name; no hyphens (they are separators): scopes the env directory and the lock key

name.description: member identity; must equal the member file's service (hyphens allowed)

file.description: path to deploy.yml/accessory.yml, relative to the group directory

needs.description: members that must be ready first; the install order is their topological sort

services.description: members; array order only breaks ties, needs decides the real order
